verdict.rationale: Goodwin's IP Litigation page claims a dedicated trade-secrets and employee-mobility practice and notes that trade-secret cases are time-sensitive. Its Employment page documents restrictive covenant agreements, which bears on employee mobility. The documentation is a brief first-party claim only, so the story is not fully covered. Missing for 10: documented confidentiality-program or trade-secret protection counseling work, specific trade-secret litigation matters or outcomes, any detail on employee-mobility dispute handling, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm documents trade-secret protection work — confidentiality programs, employee-mobility disputes, or trade-secret litigation

citations.quote: We have one of the most comprehensive trade secrets and employee mobility practices in the nation. Trade secret cases are particularly time sensitive.
We develop and negotiate employment agreements, restrictive covenant agreements, compensation plans and employment separation agreements.
